method.comparison: Unmodified-response primary visits only. Three cold runs per route/viewport; report all values and median/minimum/maximum. No run is discarded.
method.repeatedRegression: A median increase above 20% is repeated when at least two of three candidate observations exceed 1.2 times the baseline median. This is descriptive local evidence, not a statistical significance test. A zero baseline has no percentage ratio.
method.longTasks: Long tasks are partitioned by overlap duration into navigation-to-scene-ready startup, ready-to-active-window settling/early animation, and the final two-second active window. A boundary-crossing task can count in two overlap counts, but durations are split without duplication. Full original task duration and original entries are retained.
method.diagnostics: Separate patched renderer visits; their timings/transfers never enter primary medians. Visible candidate windows include active ambient animation; baseline visible windows may remain idle.
method.sourceProvenance: Candidate exact product-source/build inventories captured before measurement and again after generation audit. Frozen baseline serves a dist-only directory; source inventory comes from its immutable commit and current build files are compared with the preserved original baseline build inventory.
method.requestAudit: Inspect every primary Resource Timing pathname and identify detail/simulation named assets and chunks. Complete path lists and per-visit resources remain available; failed requests are separately included. Scene textures embedded in GLBs count within GLB body bytes.
